data.narrative:
Performance Drone Works, founded by Ryan Gury, is a Series B-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $110M+ to date. The valuation landscape for this sector comprises eight private peers including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation, with no comparable public companies available for direct benchmarking.

Given the limited peer dataset, only the stage-progression method proved applicable. Using total capital raised of $110M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x yields an implied valuation of $209M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Drones & Autonomous peer set—while five same-sector peers exist, fewer than three met the required filters for statistical reliability.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $178M (low) to $240M (high), centered at $209M. This single-method result carries material uncertainty given reliance on one approach and the absence of public company benchmarks to validate sector multiples. Key variables affecting the range include the durability of the Series B-to-next-stage step-up assumption for this particular subsector and the comparability of the $110M raised figure as a valuation proxy. A more robust analysis would require either additional private comparables at identical or adjacent stages, or access to precedent transaction data within autonomous systems and logistics.
